mapper.select: SELECT pay.id, form.number, m.sku, m.name mname, p.location image, c.name cname, entry.orderprice, tp.name fee_type, pay.payprice, pay.remark, pay.opttime, u.name operator_name, gp.name groupname FROM t_erp_purchase_form_payment pay LEFT JOIN t_erp_purchase_form_entry entry ON entry.id = pay.formentryid LEFT JOIN t_erp_purchase_form form ON form.id = entry.formid LEFT JOIN t_erp_material m ON m.id = entry.materialid LEFT JOIN t_amazon_group gp ON gp.id = m.groupid LEFT JOIN t_erp_customer c ON c.id = entry.supplier LEFT JOIN t_picture p ON p.id = m.image LEFT JOIN t_erp_fin_project tp ON tp.id = pay.projectid LEFT JOIN t_userinfo u ON u.id = pay.operator WHERE pay.period_rollover_id = #{rolloverId} ORDER BY pay.opttime DESC
